posts.name: AgentSky
posts.tagline: Any harness, any LLM — cloud-hosted agents on demand.
posts.description: Managed agent as a service: launch a long-horizon AI agent in one click — Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, or OpenClaw — with full history, managed recovery, and access through WhatsApp, iMessage, Telegram, Slack, web, API developers, and CLI.

posts.name: Ctruh Studio
posts.tagline: Create interactive 3D and XR experiences without coding
posts.description: Ctruh Studio is an AI-powered no-code platform that lets anyone create, customise and publish interactive 3D experiences for websites. Generate 3D assets with AI, build immersive product showcases, virtual stores, configurators and AR experiences directly in your browser.

posts.name: Airtop for Google Ads Automation
posts.tagline: Build campaigns, optimize spend, and create reports.
posts.description: Airtop builds, monitors, and optimizes your Google Ads campaigns from a conversation. Keyword research, campaign creation, waste audits, and performance reporting — no expertise required.

posts.name: Qwen3.8-Max
posts.tagline: Qwen’s most capable model for coding and cowork
posts.description: Qwen Studio offers comprehensive functionality spanning chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search integration, tool utilization, and artifacts.

posts.name: Plethora
posts.tagline: Youtube for interactive content
posts.description: Plethora is a platform for interactive content: a feed where micro-experiences live. Mini-games, puzzles, digital fidgets, interactive art, tiny worlds, educational simulations. Every bit can be touched, moved, poked, and played with. The content responds to you.

posts.name: Appllama
posts.tagline: Study 25,000+ screens from top-earning iOS apps
posts.description: Appllama is a design-research platform for app creators. Search 25,000+ screens from 600+ of the App Store’s top-earning iOS apps; follow complete onboarding, paywall, home and in-app flows; inspect UI elements, colors and fonts; and see revenue, downloads and ratings in context. New apps arrive weekly, captured live from the store. Start free no card required.

posts.name: yapyap
posts.tagline: Own your voice again. Local-first voice & meeting recorder.
posts.description: Every meeting recorder ships your audio to the cloud and bills you monthly. yapyap does neither. It records, transcribes, names your speakers, and turns talk into summaries and action items entirely on your own machine. “Lenses” reshape each recording into whatever you need: a summary, a to-do list, or a decision log. You can install more or build your own. Prefer the cloud? Optionally connect any major provider: OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq. Either way, yapyap is yours forever. No subscription.

posts.name: Snapdown
posts.tagline: Turn anything on your Mac screen into clean Markdown
posts.description: Snapdown turns any part of your Mac screen into structured Markdown, preserving headings, lists, tables, and text instead of flattening everything into plain OCR. Capture with one shortcut, paste anywhere, and keep every screenshot local on Apple silicon.

posts.name: claudemon
posts.tagline: Wild Pokémon appear while you wait for Claude Code
posts.description: Half of Claude Code is waiting. claudemon makes that time a game: your prompts are steps through the grass, every 20s of work another step. Something jumps out, the status line says so, you fight it in a second terminal tab. All 151, fully local, no account.

posts.name: mpai
posts.tagline: Make existing Codex and Claude Code sessions multiplayer
posts.description: Open-source terminal multiplayer for Codex and Claude Code. Join a teammate's explicitly shared native session from another Mac, arrive with the real context, and prompt with your name attached. Tailscale stays private; the host Mac stays in control.

posts.name: Hand Wave
posts.tagline: Turn sign language into speech with smart glasses
posts.description: Hand Wave turns sign language into text and speech using the camera on Meta smart glasses. It also works cross-platform (iOS + web). Under the hood is a lightweight, open-source neural network trained on Google’s FSBoard dataset and built to run locally across devices (wip).

posts.name: PassiveShorts
posts.tagline: AI Faceless Video Generator for TikTok & YouTube
posts.description: AI faceless video generator that auto-posts to YouTube and TikTok. Pick a topic, a voice, and a schedule. We write, voice, caption, and post every Short for you.

posts.name: MascotAI
posts.tagline: Animated SVG mascot studios for apps that need a personality
posts.description: Hey hunters! I’m the maker of MascotAI. I kept seeing apps launch with great products and forgettable faces. Illustration budgets are huge; generic AI avatars feel lifeless in product UI. So we built studios the way we’d ship them ourselves: animated SVG packs with gestures, themes, and parts you can actually toggle not one-off PNG images.

posts.name: Murmell
posts.tagline: Cloud canvas where your team and AI agents works together
posts.description: Murmell is a shared cloud canvas where your team and AI agents work in the same room, on the same repo, with a preview and more coming in the future. Close your laptop and the work keeps going. Agents claim files before they write, so people and agents can move at once without overwriting each other. Run Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, and OpenCode together today, with more agents on the way (OpenClaw, Hermes, and more), and your work lands back in git, so you can always find your projects there.

posts.name: Doxy
posts.tagline: Markdown & HTML editor, without the LaTeX pain
posts.description: Doxy is a browser-based editor for creating clean, professional documents with Markdown and HTML without the complexity of LaTeX or the frustration of compile times. Write, format, and preview your work in one simple, fast editor.

posts.name: gesture.live
posts.tagline: Play live electronic music with your hands using your webcam
posts.description: Play live electronic music with your hands over a webcam. Chords, bass, drums and effects, performed through gestures.

posts.name: Inventory
posts.tagline: Search every AI Agent & IDE Conversation
posts.description: Inventory is the private, local index for every Cursor, Claude Code, Zed, Codex and Kiro conversation. No signups, no cloud, one-time fee.

posts.name: MacDupl
posts.tagline: Clone any Mac app into a fully isolated instance
posts.description: MacDupl clones the Mac apps you already use into fully isolated instances — separate logins, separate data, separate Dock icons. Work and personal, side by side.

posts.name: The Garden of Mind
posts.tagline: Your subconscious mind as a living 3D garden you water daily
posts.description: The Garden of Mind is a visualisation of your subconscious mind. Whatever you hold in your attention gets planted in you — so plant one thing on purpose. Write an intention and it becomes a seed in a living 3D garden. Water it two minutes a day: read it, breathe with it, picture it as already true. The plant grows across real calendar days, so what you see is what you kept choosing. Free to start, no account, nothing to install. Founders Pro is €29 once — nothing renews, ever.

posts.name: CoachAI
posts.tagline: Your iPhone camera watches your form, rep by rep
posts.description: CoachAI uses your phone's camera to count your reps and correct your form in real time - a personal trainer's eyes in your pocket.

posts.name: Open Minis
posts.tagline: An on-device AI Agent that runs on your phone, open & secure
posts.description: Open Minis is a free, open-source AI agent for iOS and Android that does more than chat — it gives the model a real computer to work with. A sandboxed Alpine Linux shell runs on your device: it installs packages, runs Python, edits real files and drives a browser. Around it, 30+ native bridges reach HealthKit, HomeKit, Calendar, Photos. etc. Bring your own model — Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, Grok, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Keys and data never leave your phone. Free and Open Source.

posts.name: Radian
posts.tagline: Open-Source React Components and Figma Design System
posts.description: Our biggest release yet expands Radian Version 0.3 with new production-ready React components, UI blocks, design assets, improved colors, and better documentation. New components, 30+ added UI blocks, 90+ brand logos, 69 file icons, rounded country flags, Star Rating, 17 utility color palettes, improved design tokens, refreshed docs, and a faster, cleaner developer experience.

posts.name: A1
posts.tagline: The design gallery your AI agent can search too
posts.description: A collection of the best-designed websites on the internet. Each one hand-picked by me. 1,128 websites, 3,207 sections, 2,589 pages, 562 fonts, and the 501 creators behind the websites. Filter by type, category, style, colour, technology, or font. Save anything to a board, and export as a moodboard with a few clicks. It’s all on A1’s MCP server too, so your AI agent can search and reference it.

posts.name: ToolPDFs
posts.tagline: 57 private document tools that run in your browser
posts.description: ToolPDFs is a privacy-first browser workspace with 57 tools for PDFs, images, text, data, and developer tasks. Convert, compress, merge, split, organize, sign, protect, extract, resize, format, and generate files without installing software. Supported tasks run locally on your device, so documents are never uploaded, stored, or inspected. The free plan includes all tools, 20 daily operations, files up to 25 MB, no account, and no card. Built for students, freelancers, teams, and businesses.

posts.name: Ovandor
posts.tagline: Personal Intelligence. Your thinking, compounded.
posts.description: A workspace holds what you file. A chatbot answers what you ask. Neither gives you back your own thinking. Ovandor does: one living map built from your voice notes, transcripts, and documents — surfacing the patterns, the contradictions, and the January insight that explains your July decision. No folders. No tags. No prompting. Yours, compounded.

posts.name: Visuan
posts.tagline: Branded B2B blog visuals and LinkedIn carousels in 1 click
posts.description: Visuan reads your B2B article, pulls the key points, and generates branded blog visuals plus a matching LinkedIn carousel in your brand style. Everything comes editable in layers, so you can change a word without regenerating the image.

posts.name: Aimeterly
posts.tagline: Usage, cost & audit analytics for Claude Code teams
posts.description: Aimeterly is a managed dashboard for organizations rolling out Claude Code. Distribute one settings snippet — no infrastructure to run — and see usage (DAU/WAU/MAU, sessions, tokens by model), estimated cost by team, user, and model, productivity metrics (lines of code, commits, PRs, acceptance rate), and an opt-in audit log of prompts and file edits. Data appears within 5 minutes. Free plan available; every new organization starts with a Pro trial — no credit card required.

posts.name: Momentito
posts.tagline: Small daily experiments, done together
posts.description: Momentito is a community experiment companion. Everyone joins the same 30-day experiment at once (rolling start, so you can jump in any day). Each day you check in for about 60 seconds: a mood score, an impact score, and a small prompt tied to the experiment. You see how the group is doing alongside your own trend, and collect a shareable card as you go. No ads, no cost. Built solo, still small on purpose.

posts.name: GueauxStudio
posts.tagline: Video made from real conversation, not scripts
posts.description: Every AI video tool on the market either fakes the person with synthetic avatars or hands them a script and hopes for the best. GueauxStudio does neither. It's an AI interviewer — it asks real questions, listens, and turns that conversation into a finished video. No avatars. No cloned voices. No teleprompter. You talk like you actually talk. Works on any phone, no app required.

posts.name: SELF Phone
posts.tagline: The AI Phone That Pays You to Compute
posts.description: SELF Phone is an AI-first smartphone that transforms your device into an active AI node. Powered by SELF OS, it runs AI agents, downloads Resonatia models, syncs to the mesh, and earns ESSENCE by processing AI API requests. Built for privacy with Aura Shield, it supports local and cloud AI, satellite communication, and an open developer platform with integrations for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, and more.

posts.name: Lizard Studio
posts.tagline: Claude Code in Chrome, looking at the same page as you
posts.description: Claude Code that sits in the Google Chrome side panel and sees the page you are building: text, code, console logs, network calls. It can click, type, pick colours and measure gaps between elements. If you spot any bug or find that some element looks wrong, you directly point to it and Claude fixes the code. 100% open source, use with your own Claude subscription.

posts.name: Bylder.app
posts.tagline: A calm space for the builder community
posts.description: Welcome to Bylder, we've got a lot of space for your journey here. Follow generously to see real work. Share honest updates. Create & complete your to-dos. Ask & answer questions. Step inside a thoughtfully designed community for builders.

posts.name: Nevent
posts.tagline: Marketing platform for leisure events
posts.description: Libera el potencial de tu evento con Nevent. CRM completo, email marketing, SMS, chatbot IA e insights de audiencia para venues, festivales y promotores...

posts.name: Orbit
posts.tagline: Add tasks from your phone. AI agents build them in parallel
posts.description: Write your tasks the way you would write them on a sticky note. Orbit puts a coding agent on each one, in its own git worktree, so ten features build at the same time and nothing collides. When an agent needs a decision it rises into one queue you can answer from your phone. When it finishes, your lint, typecheck and tests decide whether it is really done. Free for macOS and Windows, no account, bring your own API keys.

posts.name: Coderrr
posts.tagline: Your friendly neighbourhood opensource coding agent
posts.description: A powerful CLI tool that writes, debugs, and ships code alongside you. Like Claude Code, but free and open source. AI-powered coding agent that analyzes tasks, creates actionable plans, and executes commands.

posts.name: Screen Stickynote
posts.tagline: Stickynote on your browser, No login required
posts.description: Free online sticky notes app. Enhance your productivity with Screen Stickynote, an offline-first infinite virtual canvas featuring realistic 3D skeuomorphic sticky notes. Enjoy real-time cross-tab sync, local backups, and task reminder alarms directly on your desktop.

posts.name: KyttoMCP
posts.tagline: Manage MCP servers across Claude, Cursor, VS Code & Codex
posts.description: Kytto is a focused macOS and Windows control panel for managing MCP servers across Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and Codex. See which servers are active in each client, estimate the context cost of their tool definitions, and update configuration files from one clear view. Kytto backs up before every write, saves atomically, preserves unrelated settings, and keeps everything local. The first public beta is free and requires no account.

posts.name: BentoBox
posts.tagline: Sandbox any AI agent in seconds.
posts.description: BentoBox kernel-level sandbox with compartmentalized isolated execution for any coding agent - Devaretanmay/BentoBox

posts.name: Spacement
posts.tagline: Where property owners meet solar, EV and vending operators
posts.description: Solar companies need roofs. EV charging operators need parking spots. Vending operators need entrance areas. Advertisers need walls. Today they find them by cold calling property managers. Spacement is a directory for exactly that. Owners list their space for free and stay in control. Operators pay a flat monthly fee for access and contact details. No commission on any deal, and no involvement in the contract. Live in Germany. Web and iOS, Android coming soon.

posts.name: SindriCAD
posts.tagline: Free, open source parametric CAD for 3D printing
posts.description: SindriCAD is a free, open source parametric CAD app for 3D printing, with solid modeling, printable surface textures, and STL/STEP/3MF export. Public beta out now for Linux, Windows, and Mac.

posts.name: Due or Die
posts.tagline: A meaner task planner where deadlines have consequences
posts.description: I created Due or Die after struggling with apps that reward you for completing tasks on time, as that wasn't my struggle. My gap was needing a penalty for being lazy, for NOT doing my stuff on time. Plus I wanted some personality to this, do not only give penalties, but to hurl insults, add friction, generally be annoying when I'm not on top of business.

posts.name: Watermelon
posts.tagline: Open-source Android music streaming, ad-free forever
posts.description: Watermelon is an open-source Android music streaming platform that delivers free, ad-free music in a beautiful native app. Stream virtually any track with yt-dlp, organize your library, create playlists, and enjoy a smooth Material Design experience. For developers and privacy enthusiasts, Watermelon includes a self-hostable backend, giving you full control over your music streaming experience.

posts.name: Divvy
posts.tagline: Scan the bill. Split it by who had what.
posts.description: Divvy helps groups split any food bill based on what each person had. Scan the receipt, assign the items, and it works out shared dishes, uneven portions, tax, tip, and service charges. It also checks the numbers against the final total and produces a clear breakdown to share. No account or download required.

posts.name: KnowMyFace
posts.tagline: AI face analysis with hairstyle and makeup recommendations
posts.description: KnowMyFace turns one clear photo into 41 explainable measurements across face shape, facial features, attractiveness, face age, and visible skin condition. It connects the results to personalized hairstyle and makeup guidance, so users get practical next steps instead of a single black-box score. Free preview, one-time payment, no subscription, and privacy-first data deletion.

posts.name: Tripvora
posts.tagline: Plan road trips without Google Maps restrictions
posts.description: Road trip planner. Build day-by-day routes with stops, fuel and lodging costs on a live map. AI suggests where to stop. Export to Google Maps in one click.

posts.name: Asten BaaS
posts.tagline: Zero-server Cloud Saves, Auth & Leaderboards for Unity
posts.description: Asten BaaS is a lightweight C# SDK for Unity developers to add Cloud Saves with Smart Debouncing, Hybrid Auth (Device ID + OTP), and real-time Global Leaderboards to games in under 5 minutes without writing server code or managing databases.

posts.name: Revyme
posts.tagline: Open source design-oriented website builder
posts.description: Design websites with pixel-perfect control and ship real Next.js code you own. Revyme is the open-source visual website builder for engineers and designers — no black box, no lock-in, export your code anytime.

posts.name: Jerry
posts.tagline: AI invoicing that chases clients until you're paid
posts.description: Jerry is the AI billing assistant for freelancers. 3 Invoices, recurring billing, Stripe payments, VAT/reverse charge, PDF import, and an AI chase engine that works 24/7 - everything a freelancer needs to get paid, in one place. Free for your first 3 invoices. No card required.

posts.name: Vibe Sensei
posts.tagline: AI coding agents in parallel, Your cockpit for AI coding
posts.description: Stop managing AI agents one at a time. Vibe Sensei is a native desktop cockpit for orchestrating Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, and other coding agents in parallel. Every agent works inside a visible terminal, isolated by Git worktrees and coordinated through missions, squads, live handoffs, and shared tasks. It runs locally on your machine using your own provider accounts, so your code, tokens, and workflow stay under your control.

posts.name: Olo Security
posts.tagline: AI freedom, without the risk.
posts.description: Olo is a color the human eye cannot see. It exists, fully real, yet it never reaches us. Your data should work the same way, invisible to AI.

posts.name: Trace
posts.tagline: The 5-minute tech brief for builders
posts.description: Trace turns the day’s AI and tech news, launches, open-source projects, and technical conversations into one clear brief with takeaways and source links. Pro also gives your AI agent read-only access to the same live signal.

posts.name: NeuroSpicy
posts.tagline: Energy and mood tracking built for ADHD brains
posts.description: ADHD energy and mood tracking app. 10-second check-ins reveal your patterns and help you stop the boom-bust cycle. Free and private.

posts.name: Host Better AI Website Analyzer
posts.tagline: Free AI-powered website audits beyond Google PageSpeed.
posts.description: Host Better AI Website Analyzer helps developers, businesses, and marketers understand exactly how their websites perform. Enter any URL to receive an AI-generated summary, performance analysis, SEO insights, Core Web Vitals, accessibility reports, best practices, overall website health scores, industry comparisons, and prioritized recommendations—all in one beautiful report. Free to use and built to simplify website optimization.

posts.name: Green Guard
posts.tagline: Diagnose plant problems with AI, instantly
posts.description: 🌿 Green Guard — AI Plant Health Scanner for Gardeners 🌿 Snap a photo of any plant or leaf and get an instant AI diagnosis disease, pest, or deficiency with clear home treatment steps. 🎁 Early users who join the waitlist get lifetime free access!

posts.name: AutoMind
posts.tagline: Smart car maintenance & auto service tracker
posts.description: AutoMind is a practical car maintenance app designed for vehicle owners. Track your vehicle’s overall condition, monitor remaining resource life for auto parts and consumables, and store your complete repair and service history in one intuitive interface.

posts.name: Islamic Quotes & Duas
posts.tagline: Reconnect with your faith through powerful Islamic quotes.
posts.description: Reconnect with your faith through powerful Islamic quotes, duas, and meaningful reminders In today’s fast-paced life, it’s easy to forget the importance of reflection. This app is designed to bring you closer to Allah through simple, short, and impactful reminders you can read anytime. ✨ What You’ll Get: Explore a rich collection of Islamic quotes and reminders based on Quran and authentic teachings. Each quote is carefully selected to inspire patience, gratitude, faith, and inner peace.

posts.name: IO Tools 3.0 (Revamp)
posts.tagline: 900+ free tools and growing, redesigned - now with API + MCP
posts.description: IO Tools is a free tools platform - 900+ utilities for everyday tasks, no signup needed. 3.0 is a full rebuild: redesigned UI, faster load times across the board, and a public API + MCP server so you can plug IO Tools straight into your AI agent workflows instead of opening a browser tab. We've grown from ~40 to 700+ daily clicks. This release is about making that same toolkit usable anywhere - browser, API, or agent.

posts.name: ManyGPT
posts.tagline: Every AI model. One workspace. One shared memory.
posts.description: ManyGPT brings multiple AI models into one workspace with shared memory. Instead of switching between separate tools and repeatedly explaining your context, you can work across models while keeping conversations, preferences, and project knowledge connected. It is designed to reduce context switching and make everyday AI workflows faster and more consistent.

posts.name: blok
posts.tagline: An AI-powered Discord alternative with a gacha twist
posts.description: Blok is a native desktop chat platform for communities - voice, video, and screen share, plus an AI co-pilot (b.ai.t) that summarizes channels, runs polls, and translates. Level up, complete quests, and open gacha loot boxes for cosmetics as you chat.

posts.name: SoloSpace
posts.tagline: Entrepreneurs, Solopreneurs, Startup, Indie Hackers
posts.description: SoloSpace is a 2D virtual co-working space designed for Solopreneurs, Startup Founders, Solo Founders, Entrepreneurs, Indie Hackers, Freelancers, and Remote Teams. We bridge the gap between deep focus and real-time social presence. In an era of remote work, focusing alone for hours can feel monotonous. SoloSpace offers a peaceful 2.5D pixel environment where you can pull up a desk, immerse in deep work, or pop into the Coffee Zone for spontaneous micro-interactions with fellow builders.

posts.name: Sayora AI (UK)
posts.tagline: The AI receptionist for small business
posts.description: Sayora is the AI receptionist for UK small businesses. It answers every call, takes the caller's details, and texts you the lead the moment the call ends.

posts.name: Restaurant Finder
posts.tagline: The best restaurants from Instagram & TikTok videos
posts.description: Pick a food and a city, and see the restaurants Instagram & TikTok creators actually recommend. Ranked by real creator buzz, with the videos as proof.

posts.name: FocusFlow
posts.tagline: Block distracting sites until your tasks are done.
posts.description: Block distracting sites until tasks are done. Focus timer, streaks, analytics & beautiful design.

posts.name: Litmus
posts.tagline: The Lighthouse for AI search visibility
posts.description: The Lighthouse for AI search. Litmus scores how visible your site is to ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews. Unlike tools that just ask an LLM to grade your site (different answer every time you ask), Litmus is fully rule based and deterministic, same input, same score, always. It also tells you exactly what to fix and how to fix it. You can fix it with AI or sell the solution to clients.

posts.name: Cam Master: Dual Recorder
posts.tagline: Portrait + Landscape Video App
posts.description: Capture more of every moment with Cam Master, a powerful camera app built for creators who want greater control and multiple perspectives.

posts.name: LeanLoop Weight Loss Coach
posts.tagline: One focus a day. No calorie counting. A coach that adapts.
posts.description: LeanLoop is for people who tried strict trackers and burned out. Instead of logging everything, you pick one realistic daily focus, reflect without shame, and come back tomorrow with a clearer plan. Take a 2-minute quiz to find your weight-loss archetype, and LeanLoop shapes the coaching around how you actually start, stall, and restart. It rewards *adding* filling whole foods — never cutting or counting.

posts.name: ATLX Tools
posts.tagline: Free online tools for developers, creators & everyone
posts.description: Meet ATLX Tools, a growing collection of free, fast, and privacy-friendly online tools built to help developers, creators, and everyday users get things done faster. What makes ATLX Tools different: • Fast and lightweight tools with no unnecessary complexity • Privacy-focused approach, process your data safely • Simple interfaces built for everyone, not just technical users • A constantly expanding library of useful tools in one place

posts.name: BoxSmartly
posts.tagline: Scan a box, find what's inside. That's it.
posts.description: Give every moving box a QR label, then scan or search to find anything you packed. Free to start on iPhone and iPad. No account needed.

posts.name: 1RM Workout Tracker & Log
posts.tagline: Workout tracker & 1RM calculator for serious lifters
posts.description: 1RM.fit is a workout tracker built around one number: your one-rep max. Log sets in seconds, auto-calculate and track 1RM PRs, generate routines with AI, and train with your coach or friends. Free on iOS, Android and web — no ads, no locked logging.

posts.name: USAVizo
posts.tagline: Practice your US visa interview with private AI feedback
posts.description: Practice a U.S. visa mock interview, review sourced F-1, B1/B2 and H-1B experiences, and improve concise answers before interview day.

posts.name: Titan Autopilot
posts.tagline: Automate overdue invoice follow-ups
posts.description: Titan Autopilot helps contractors, freelancers, and service businesses stop losing time to overdue invoice follow-up. Select up to 10 past-due invoices, approve the recipients, and Titan prepares an audited reminder queue. Pro members receive one recovery sprint each month; configured email delivery can send the approved reminders automatically.

posts.name: PyTorch Beginner's Guide
posts.tagline: Learn PyTorch from scratch with simple examples.
posts.description: PyTorch Beginner's Guide is a free resource for learning PyTorch from scratch. It explains the basics of deep learning with clear examples and simple language. You'll learn how to install PyTorch, write your first program, understand tensors, and build a strong foundation for AI and machine learning. It's designed for students, developers, and anyone starting their PyTorch journey.

posts.name: Dodast-Synced Media Player
posts.tagline: Every phone in the room, playing in perfect sync
posts.description: Dodast turns any group of phones, tablets, or laptops on the same Wi-Fi into one perfectly synced player. When you're together in the same room, load up your music and video library and let every connected device play as one — in step, down to matching lip-sync on video. Each person gets their own volume and latency controls right from their phone. Built with Kotlin Multiplatform, so Android and iOS get the exact same experience — great for shared listening and watch parties.

posts.name: EdulabsAI
posts.tagline: Everything a Teacher Needs. One Intelligent Platform.
posts.description: 🚀 Meet EdulabsAI – The Complete AI Teaching Platform EdulabsAI is an AI-powered platform for teachers, schools, and educational institutions worldwide. Create curriculum-aligned lesson plans, presentations, quizzes, worksheets, assessments, and classroom resources in minutes. Supporting multiple international curricula and AI-powered editing, EdulabsAI helps educators save time, personalize learning, and teach with confidence. Free during beta.

posts.name: Livewire.synovix
posts.tagline: a template for electricians
posts.description: LIVEWIRE is a premium website template built for electricians and electrical service businesses. It features a modern design, smooth animations, SEO optimization, responsive layouts, and conversion-focused sections to help businesses attract more customers and launch faster.

posts.name: Sigmacta
posts.tagline: A social network built to grow you, not hook you
posts.description: Sigmacta bundles chat, stories, a feed, free music/podcasts/audiobooks, and yearly goals with an AI coach into one app — built solo, no team, no funding. Sign up with just a username, no email or phone needed.

posts.name: FaceFit
posts.tagline: Find your face shape and styles that suit you
posts.description: FaceFit helps you discover your face shape from a photo, understand the features behind the result, and explore hairstyle and glasses guidance for oval, round, square, heart, diamond, and oblong face shapes.

posts.name: TryDevSnip
posts.tagline: JSON, JWT & cron tools — pastes stay local
posts.description: Free local-first developer toolkit in the browser: JSON format/diff, cron helper, timestamps, JWT decode, hash, Base64, UUIDs. Processing stays in your tab — don’t paste secrets into a stranger’s formatter. No signup. An Acsaven product.

posts.name: SecAI
posts.tagline: AI-powered cybersecurity platform for Linux servers
posts.description: SecAI is an AI-powered cybersecurity platform for Linux servers, built by Tech Steps LLC in UAE. Deploy a lightweight agent in 60 seconds and get real-time threat detection, automated IP blocking, DDoS protection (Layer 4 & 7), and daily AI security audits. Built for SMEs across the UAE and MENA that need enterprise-grade protection without a dedicated security team. Includes compliance reporting aligned with UAE NESA and PDPL.

posts.name: Metadata Remover
posts.tagline: Remove hidden image metadata privately in your browser
posts.description: Metadata Remover is a free, privacy-first web tool that strips EXIF, GPS, XMP, IPTC, and AI-generation metadata from JPEG, PNG, and WebP images. Processing happens locally in your browser, so files never leave your device. No uploads or sign-up—just clean, download, and verify your images in seconds.

posts.name: ComplyMenu
posts.tagline: Digital food safety logs for independent restaurants.
posts.description: In a restaurant: temperature logs (walk-in coolers, freezers, hot-holding, cook temps), cleaning/sanitation checklists done at set intervals, corrective action records when something's out of range, and staff food-handler certifications on file.
